scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n CSS,JS -c magenta,cyan "npm run watch:css" "npm run watch:js"
scripts.dev:live: concurrently -k -n FLASK,SASS,JS,SYNC -c blue,magenta,cyan,green "npm run serve:flask" "npm run watch:css" "npm run watch:js" "wait-on tcp:8000 && npm run serve:proxy"
scripts.dev:live:attach: concurrently -k -n SASS,SYNC -c magenta,green "npm run watch:css" "wait-on http://mo.local && npm run serve:proxy"
